newsitem.title: USA: CME hog futures lower, pork bellies turn lower.
newsitem.headline: CME hog futures lower, pork bellies turn lower.

text.p: CME hog futures posted losses while pork bellies started mixed and then turned lower.
The large premium of futures to cash and steady to possibly easier cash hog prices early weighed on hog futures, traders said. Profit taking added to losses.
Pork belly futures also ran into profit taking after opening higher on carryover demand linked to light slaughter and strong cash belly prices.
At 0916 CST, hog futures were off 0.300 cent a lb to up 0.075 with December off 0.100 at 57.400 cents. Pork bellies were off 0.800 to up 0.125 with February off most at 73.825 cents.
